official_method: POST /v1/responses/input_tokens reports the model input count, including formatting tokens for request structure.
local_estimate_limit: Tokenizing visible text, counting UTF-8 bytes or adding an undocumented fixed allowance does not establish the full-request upper bound in this record.
decision: Do not silently add count requests or relabel the frozen maximum_total_api_calls as generation-only. No verified host bound is issued now.
future_resolution: Either document a supported offline full-request bound, or fix count-request accounting and its implementation in a separate revision/run before adopting the API method. Preserve the current conditions and binding.
per_request_linkage_if_resolved: If a separate count request is used: its exact bytes, outcome and linkage to the generation request
dynamic_restart_inputs: R5 must use actual saved reads. Initial fixtures or a mock request count cannot certify later live inputs. A changed request invalidates its previous bound.
